label: Diagram 22
caption: Diagram 22 An example of a self-contained changing room for individual use
description:
The drawing, titled "An example of a self-contained changing room for individual use", comprises two views.

The upper view, labelled "Elevation", shows a wall assembly. At the top, "Alarm pull card" is on the left and "2100mm minimum unobstructed height" is on the right. On the left are a "Back rest" and a "Drop-down rail". In the centre are a "Vertical grab rail length 500mm min.", a "Horizontal grab rail" and an "Alarm reset". A "Tip-up seat" sits at the base on the left, with vertical dimensions 680mm and 480mm. To the right, "Clothes hooks at 1400mm and 1050mm above floor level" and a "Possible location of towel rail" are shown, with an 800mm dimension on the right. The label "Drop-down rail on side wall" appears at the bottom.

The lower view, labelled "Plan", depicts a rectangular room 2200mm by 2000mm with a door and swing arc at the bottom right. It shows "Grab rail", "Tip-up seat", "Alarm pull card", "Clothes hooks", "Mirror", "Drop-down rails", and a "Possible location of towel rail (or locate in self-contained shower room)". A "1500mm x 1500mm wheelchair turning space" is marked, with dimensions 250mm, 600mm, 500mm, 200mm and 320mm along the top; 500mm, 1200mm and 320mm on the left; and 650mm inside.
